name: Mud Pie
text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
After eating a mud pie, your skin thickens and cracks slightly, resembling dried mud. You gain resistance 2 to slashing and piercing damage and resistance 4 to fire. You also gain weakness 3 to water. These effects last for 1 minute. After the effects wear off, the extra skin flakes off and falls to the ground.

Effect: Mud Pie
